## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Hé lùn zuǎn yào* in 3 fascicles is a late-Míng compilation of essentials from *[Huáyán jīng hé lùn 華嚴經合論](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0066)* (X223, 120 fascicles) by [方澤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%B9%E6%BE%A4) Fāngzé — a compact alternative to [李贄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E8%B4%84) Lǐ Zhuówú's *[Hé lùn jiǎn yào 簡要](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0067)* (X225, 4 fascicles). The two abridgements together attest the broader late-Míng project of making Lǐ Tōngxuán's commentary accessible to lay readers.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1580 – 1644) reflects the late-Míng period during which the *Hé lùn*'s readership expanded among educated lay-Buddhist intellectuals. The work follows the chapter-organisation of the parent sūtra in 39 chapters, providing for each chapter a compact summary drawn from Lǐ Tōngxuán's commentary. Together with [Lǐ Zhuówú's abridgement](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0067) it documents the late-Míng renaissance of interest in Lǐ Tōngxuán's contemplative reading of the *Avataṃsaka* among the educated lay reading public.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X226) collection.
